title: Three publication families: Valensole
dek: A six-minute route through one catalogue record and three distinct archive publication families, ending with a disciplined comparison.

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 1
checkpoints.title: Anchor the investigation to the catalogue record
checkpoints.guidance: Start with the stable record ID and preserved catalogue fields. Treat classifications, names, and explanation codes as recorded data whose meaning still requires source-level checking.

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 2
checkpoints.title: Review the coordinate provenance
checkpoints.guidance: Check how the location was positioned and what precision the public map actually claims before using geographic proximity as evidence.

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 3
checkpoints.title: Open the APRO route
checkpoints.guidance: Record the issue, page-routing label, and confidence before reading. The archive link helps locate relevant material; it does not validate every statement in the publication.

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 4
checkpoints.title: Follow the Lumieres dans la Nuit route
checkpoints.guidance: A second publication family broadens the trail. Note its issue identity and link precision, then inspect the scan rather than assuming its relationship to APRO.

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 5
checkpoints.title: Add the Data-Net route
checkpoints.guidance: The third publication family increases archive coverage. It does not automatically create a third independent account; chronology and citation dependence still need review.

checkpoints.label: Checkpoint 6
checkpoints.title: Compare coverage without scoring credibility
checkpoints.guidance: Place Valensole beside Sillerup and Delphos. Compare source-family breadth, link counts, dates, and missing fields without converting coverage into a credibility ranking.
